name: application-media
title: Media
description: Responsive media and avatar components for user profiles, image galleries, and content cards with flexible alignment and layouts.
useWhen: Responsive media and avatar components for user profiles, image galleries, and content cards with flexible alignment and layouts.
avoidWhen: Avoid media when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Media uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
